acceptance: ci.yml merged non-required; trigger test proves pull_request has no branch filter, merge_group present, and all six result jobs use if: always()
Shadow report: >=5 working days, every old-red/new-green or old-green/new-red disagreement explained or fixed
Measured p95: T1 <=5 min test + <=2 min setup; T2 <=15 min (if over, add shards; never drop required cases)
T2 uploads hashed wheel+sdist artifacts retrievable by commit SHA
context: Guardrails: G2 shadow, G3 ledger, G6 no settings changes in this PR. Local measurements (Apple Silicon, clean env): uv sync warm 2 s; unit 239 s/8 workers; slow 78 s; integration 227 s/8 workers; engine cases ~107 s; gate 23 s; build 7 s; install 1 s; CLI smoke 13 s. GitHub runners estimated 2-3x slower, so ~6 shards for T2.
description:
New .github/workflows/ci.yml:
- on: pull_request with NO branches filter (stacked/feature-based PRs get CI; this is what later retires pr-base-guard.yml) and merge_group.
- classify job (dlv2-20), then per-unit jobs; each unit ends in a result job named exactly core, explorer, results-data, docs, landing, tooling with if: always(); it fails on any failed/cancelled dependency and passes when the unit is untouched.
- core: T1 on pull_request (touched-unit tests, duration-balanced shards, offline adapter tests, contract tests, leak detector, 0.5 s budget); T2 on merge_group (all unit tests, required engine cases per dlv2-15, correctness gate + oracle tests on Linux, slow tests, wheel+sdist build, sha256, upload artifact keyed by commit SHA, install smoke on Linux/macOS/Windows incl. one dbgen and dsdgen run per OS, Python 3.11 and 3.14 on Linux, sdist source install, check_dependency_bounds.py).
- explorer: vitest, typecheck, build, chromium e2e, snapshot/UI mixed-version compatibility in both orders (results-explorer/src/db.ts:289 rejects older snapshots).
- docs and landing: build plus the exact-base public-site visual comparison with follower-baseline handling (port from docs.yml required result) when affected.
- results-data: submission validator + explorer contract.
- tooling: lint, workflow tests (tests/unit/workflows/test_workflow_context_availability.py; a new ci.yml trigger/always-report test replacing test_merge_group_triggers), and scripts/ruleset_drift_check.py (D7).
Shadow: non-required for >=5 working days; record every verdict disagreement with pr.yml/docs.yml/results-explorer-browser.yml.
